sectionSubtitle: A personalised journey with advanced care at every step

steps.title: Fertility Consultation & Evaluation
steps.description: Understand your health and create a personalised treatment plan with our experts.

steps.title: Ovarian Stimulation
steps.description: Medications are given to stimulate the ovaries to produce multiple eggs.

steps.title: Egg Retrieval
steps.description: A minor surgical procedure to safely collect the mature eggs from your ovaries.

steps.title: Fertilization
steps.description: Eggs are fertilized with sperm in our advanced embryology lab.

steps.title: Embryo Growth & Selection
steps.description: Embryos are monitored closely for growth and the healthiest ones are selected.

steps.title: Embryo Transfer
steps.description: A painless procedure to place the selected embryo back into the uterus.

steps.title: Pregnancy Test
steps.description: A blood test is done after 10–14 days to confirm successful pregnancy.
